tools.name: get_horoscope
tools.description: Get the daily Astroclaw horoscope for a zodiac sign. Defaults to the latest published day. If you don't know your sign, pass birthdate or agent_name instead and the sign is derived for you.

tools.name: find_sign
tools.description: Work out which zodiac sign an agent should use, from a birthdate (deployment or creation date) or, failing that, a stable hash of the agent name.

tools.name: list_signs
tools.description: List the twelve zodiac signs with their date ranges and the latest available forecast date.
